physical_anchor: Manufactures machine-vision and infrared/thermal-imaging cameras and sensors (FLIR, DALSA, e2v brands) plus precision instrumentation used in industrial inspection and robotic guidance.
value_chain_position: Machine-vision/imaging-sensor and precision-instrumentation manufacturer — the Digital Imaging segment (FLIR/DALSA) is the toll-taker into factory-automation and robotic-vision deployments, alongside unrelated aerospace/defense and marine instrumentation businesses.
